title: CBDT Extends Income Tax Return and Audit Report Due Dates for AY 2026-27
content:
# CBDT Extends Income Tax Return and Audit Report Due Dates for AY 2026-27

Ek important update hai! Government ne Assessment Year 2026-27 ke liye Income Tax Return (ITR) filing aur Audit Report submit karne ki due dates extend karne ka announcement kiya hai. This extension provides relief to taxpayers whose accounts are subject to audit under the Income-tax Act, 1961.

Here are the key details:

*   **For furnishing the Audit Report:**
    *   **Old Due Date:** September 30, 2026
    *   **New Due Date:** October 21, 2026

*   **For furnishing the Return of Income (ITR) for audited cases:**
    *   **Old Due Date:** October 31, 2026
    *   **New Due Date:** November 21, 2026

The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne yeh decision 28th September, 2026 ko ek Press Release ke through announce kiya hai. This extension specifically applies to persons mentioned at S. No. 2 in the Table below Explanation 2 to sub-section (1) of section 139 of the Income-tax Act, 1961. CBDT ne yeh bhi clarify kiya hai ki is extension ko formalize karne ke liye ek official order/notification separately issue kiya jaayega.
